about: The Workbench icons of the Tennix drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own icon (data/tennix.png, GPL 2 or later like the game), scaled to 64x64. Tennix-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Tennix.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Tennix.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for README-tennix and the COPYING files.
